title: Novena to Our Lady of Fatima
description: A nine-day prayer to Our Lady of Fatima, seeking her intercession for peace in the world, conversion of sinners, and personal holiness. This devotion centers on Mary's apparitions to three shepherd children in Fatima, Portugal, in 1917, where she revealed the importance of prayer, penance, and the rosary for the salvation of souls.
intention: For world peace, conversion of sinners, an end to war and violence, strength of families, and the grace to live the message of Fatima through prayer, penance, and devotion to the Immaculate Heart
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days, especially when seeking peace in the world, conversion of loved ones, or personal renewal. This novena is particularly meaningful in May (Mary's month), in October (month of the rosary), or when preparing for the feast of Our Lady of Fatima on May 13. Mary specifically asked at Fatima for the daily rosary, penance, and devotion to her Immaculate Heart. Those praying this novena are encouraged to also pray the rosary daily.
background_info: From May 13 to October 13, 1917, the Blessed Virgin Mary appeared six times to three shepherd children - Lucia, Francisco, and Jacinta - near Fatima, Portugal. Mary identified herself as 'Our Lady of the Rosary' and urged the children to pray the rosary daily for peace, to offer sacrifices for sinners, and to dedicate themselves to her Immaculate Heart. The apparitions culminated in the 'Miracle of the Sun,' witnessed by over 70,000 people, including skeptics and journalists. The message of Fatima emphasized prayer, penance, and conversion as the path to peace and the salvation of souls. Francisco and Jacinta Marto were canonized in 2017.

days.title: Day 1: The Message of Peace
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Lady of Fatima, you came to three innocent children in 1917, appearing as a lady 'brighter than the sun' with a message of peace for a world torn by war. At that time, the First World War was devastating Europe, and you warned that an even worse war would come if people did not turn to God. Today, our world continues to be torn by violence, terrorism, and war. Nations rise against nations, ideologies clash, and innocent people suffer. O Queen of Peace, I ask for your powerful intercession for peace in our world. Soften the hearts of those who promote violence and war. Convert those who have given themselves to hatred and terrorism. Guide world leaders to seek peaceful solutions to conflicts rather than military ones. Protect those who are fleeing violence and persecution, especially refugees. But I also recognize that peace must begin with me, in my own heart and relationships. Help me to be an instrument of peace where I live - in my family, workplace, and community. Where there is hatred, let me sow love; where there is injury, pardon; where there is doubt, faith; where there is despair, hope; where there is darkness, light; and where there is sadness, joy. Make me a channel of your peace, O Lady of Fatima. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Queen of the Holy Rosary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary appeared at Fatima during World War I with a message of peace and warning of worse conflicts if humanity did not repent. Her message remains urgent today as violence and war continue to plague our world.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Fatima, Queen of Peace, intercede for peace in our world and make me an instrument of peace in my daily life.
days.scripture: "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God." - Matthew 5:9

days.title: Day 2: The Daily Rosary
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Lady of the Rosary, at Fatima you appeared holding a rosary and repeatedly asked the children to pray the rosary every day for peace and for an end to the war. You taught them that this simple prayer is one of the most powerful weapons against evil and one of the most effective ways to obtain graces from God. Yet I must confess that I often neglect this beautiful devotion. I find excuses to skip my rosary - I am too busy, too tired, or too distracted. My mind wanders when I do pray it, and I can't focus on the mysteries. Teach me, O Mother, to love the rosary as you love it. Help me to understand that in praying the rosary, I am joining you in meditating on the life, death, and resurrection of your Son. Each Hail Mary is a rose in a spiritual bouquet that I present to you. When I say the rosary with attention and devotion, I am not just repeating words but entering into the mysteries of salvation. Help me to establish a daily habit of praying the rosary, even when it is difficult. Give me the grace to persevere even when distractions try to pull me away. May the rosary become my spiritual weapon against temptation, my comfort in sorrow, and my aid in every need. O Lady of the Rosary, draw me deeper into this devotion. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Queen of the Holy Rosary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary identified herself at Fatima as 'Our Lady of the Rosary' and emphasized daily rosary prayer for obtaining peace and salvation. The rosary invites us to meditate on Christ's life through Mary's eyes.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of the Rosary, help me to pray the rosary daily with attention and devotion, entering into the mysteries of your Son's life, death, and resurrection.
days.scripture: "But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart." - Luke 2:19

days.title: Day 3: Prayer for Sinners
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Fatima, during the apparitions, you showed the children a vision of hell and told them that many souls go there because they have no one to pray for them. In each apparition, you asked for prayers and sacrifices for sinners, especially adding to each decade of the rosary: 'O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, and lead all souls to heaven, especially those most in need of your mercy.' This prayer reveals your maternal heart that desires the salvation of all your children. I unite my prayers with yours for the conversion of sinners. I pray especially for those who have fallen away from the faith, for those caught in serious sin, for those who deny or blaspheme God, and for those who have never heard the Gospel or have rejected it. Convert their hearts, O Mother, through the power of your intercession. I also pray for those who are lukewarm in their faith, including myself at times. Revive in us a burning love for your Son and a passion for holiness. Help me to offer my daily prayers, works, joys, and sufferings for the salvation of souls. When I am tempted to think that others are too far from God to be saved, remind me that no one is beyond the reach of His mercy. O Mother of Mercy, save souls through my prayers and sacrifices. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Queen of the Holy Rosary, pray for us.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, and lead all souls to heaven, especially those most in need of your mercy.
days.reflection: Mary's plea at Fatima for prayers for sinners reveals her maternal desire that no soul be lost. The Fatima Prayer added to the rosary asks Jesus to save souls, especially those most in need of His mercy.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Fatima, I offer my prayers and sacrifices for the conversion of sinners, especially those most in need of God's mercy.
days.scripture: "In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents." - Luke 15:10

days.title: Day 4: Penance and Sacrifice
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Lady of Fatima, you told the three shepherd children that many souls go to hell because they have no one to pray and make sacrifices for them. You asked for prayers and sacrifices, especially offering up the difficulties of daily life in reparation for sins and for the conversion of sinners. In our comfortable world, sacrifice has become foreign to us. We seek pleasure and avoid pain at all costs. Yet you teach that sacrifice is not about punishing ourselves but about love - love for God expressed through self-denial, and love for others expressed through offering our sufferings for their salvation. Help me to embrace the sacrifices that come to me each day without having to be sought: the irritation of delays, the discomfort of illness, the disappointment of plans that don't work out, the fatigue of hard work, the loneliness of being misunderstood. Instead of complaining about these trials, help me to offer them willingly for the salvation of souls. Teach me also to make voluntary sacrifices: giving up small comforts, fasting when appropriate, denying myself things I legitimately want in order to grow in self-discipline and love. Help me to offer each sacrifice with love, not with resentment or pride. May each small offering be united to Christ's perfect sacrifice on the cross, gaining grace for souls who need it most. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Queen of the Holy Rosary, pray for us.
days.reflection: At Fatima, Mary called for prayer and sacrifice for the conversion of sinners. The children responded by giving up lunches, wearing rough cords, and accepting suffering with patience. Their sacrifices show that love often requires self-denial.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Fatima, help me to offer my daily sacrifices willingly for the conversion of sinners and in reparation for offenses against God.
days.scripture: "Then Jesus said to his disciples, 'Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.'" - Matthew 16:24

days.title: Day 5: The Immaculate Heart
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Fatima, during the July apparition, you showed the children your Immaculate Heart surrounded by thorns and told them that God wished to establish devotion to your Immaculate Heart throughout the world. You promised that this devotion would bring peace and that in the end your Immaculate Heart would triumph. Your Immaculate Heart is a perfect image of what every human heart should be - pure, full of love for God and neighbor, and free from all attachment to sin. The thorns around your heart represent the sins of humanity that wound your maternal heart and, more importantly, wound the Sacred Heart of your Son. I wish to console your Immaculate Heart and to have my heart become more like yours. Help me to remove the sins and selfishness that are the thorns wounding my heart and yours. Help me to grow in purity, humility, and love. Teach me to receive the sacraments frequently, especially Confession and Holy Communion, as you requested at Fatima. You asked for communion of reparation on the first Saturdays of the month - help me to practice this devotion faithfully. Make my heart clean and simple like yours, full of love for God and for all people. May devotion to your Immaculate Heart lead me closer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus. O Mother with the Immaculate Heart, transform my heart. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, which Mary requested at Fatima, recognizes her pure and loving heart as a model for all Christians. First Saturday devotions include confession, communion, rosary, and meditation on the mysteries as acts of reparation.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, make my heart like yours - pure, humble, and full of love for God and neighbor. I console your heart wounded by the sins of humanity.
days.scripture: "And a sword will pierce your own soul too." - Luke 2:35

days.title: Day 6: The Miracle of the Sun
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Lady of Fatima, on October 13, 1917, you performed what has become known as the 'Miracle of the Sun' before an estimated 70,000 people who had come to the Cova da Iria in driving rain and mud. The clouds suddenly parted, and the sun appeared as a silver disc that could be looked at directly. It then began to spin and dance, shooting out rays of light in various colors. Finally, it appeared to fall from the sky toward the earth, terrifying the crowd, before returning to its normal place. The soaked ground and people's clothes were instantly dry. This miracle, reported even by secular journalists and skeptics, confirmed that your messages were truly from God. I believe, O Mother, that you still perform miracles today - sometimes dramatic ones like the Miracle of the Sun, but more often quiet miracles of grace that transform souls. I ask for the miracle I need most in my life right now [mention your intention]. But even more, I ask for the miracle of a transformed heart and a deepened faith. Increase my trust in your Son Jesus and in His power to do the impossible. Help me to bring my needs to you with the confidence of a child approaching a loving mother. And if what I ask is not in accordance with God's will, help me to accept His will with peace and trust. O Lady of Miracles, work the miracle of grace in my heart. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Queen of the Holy Rosary, pray for us.
days.reflection: The Miracle of the Sun, witnessed by over 70,000 people on October 13, 1917, remains one of the most documented and extraordinary miracles in Church history. It confirmed the Fatima apparitions and demonstrated God's power over creation.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Fatima, I believe in your Son's power to work miracles. I entrust my needs to you, asking for the grace to accept whatever God wills.
days.scripture: "For nothing will be impossible with God." - Luke 1:37

days.title: Day 7: The Example of the Children
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Lady of Fatima, you chose three young shepherd children to receive your message and to be your witnesses to the world. Lucia, Francisco, and Jacinta were ordinary children - poor, uneducated, and simple. Yet they responded to your call with extraordinary faith, courage, and holiness. They endured mockery, interrogation, and even threats of death for refusing to deny what they had seen. They offered sacrifices for sinners with generous hearts, sometimes giving up their lunches or wearing uncomfortable cords as penance. Jacinta and Francisco died young - Francisco in 1919 and Jacinta in 1920 - and were canonized saints in 2017. Lucia lived until 2005, serving as a Carmelite nun and continuing to spread the message of Fatima. O Mother, through the intercession of these young saints, help me to learn from their example. Give me their simple, unquestioning faith that accepted your word without doubting. Give me their courage to speak truth even when facing hostility and ridicule. Give me their generosity in offering sacrifices for the salvation of souls. Their youth reminds us that holiness is not just for adults but for people of all ages. Help parents to teach their children the faith, and help children to respond with love and openness. May the example of these young saints inspire adults and children alike to take seriously the call to holiness. St. Francisco, St. Jacinta, and Ven. Lucia, pray for us. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

St. Francisco and St. Jacinta, pray for us.
days.reflection: Sts. Francisco and Jacinta Marto (canonized 2017) and Venerable Lucia dos Santos (1907-2005) show that holiness is possible at any age. Their simple faith, courage in persecution, and generous sacrifices continue to inspire millions.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Fatima, through the intercession of the Fatima children, help me to grow in faith, courage, and generosity in offering myself for the salvation of souls.
days.scripture: "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." - Matthew 19:14

days.title: Day 8: The First Saturdays
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Lady of Fatima, you later appeared to Lucia and asked for the establishment of the First Saturday devotions as an act of reparation to your Immaculate Heart. You promised to assist at the hour of death with all the graces necessary for salvation those who, on the first Saturday of five consecutive months, go to confession, receive Holy Communion, pray the rosary, and keep you company for fifteen minutes while meditating on the mysteries of the rosary. This practice of five First Saturdays is not mere ritual but a concrete way to express love and reparation. You mentioned five specific offenses against your Immaculate Heart: blasphemies against your Immaculate Conception, against your perpetual virginity, against your divine maternity, the offenses of those who teach hatred toward you in the hearts of children, and the outrages done to your sacred images. O Mother, I wish to make reparation for these and all offenses against you. I will commit to practicing the First Saturday devotions for five consecutive months as you requested. Help me to prepare well for each confession, to receive Communion with devotion, to pray the rosary with attention and love, and to spend fifteen minutes meditating on the mysteries. May this devotion deepen my love for you and bring consolation to your Immaculate Heart wounded by so many offenses. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: The Five First Saturdays devotion, requested by Mary in 1925, includes confession, communion, rosary, and 15 minutes of meditation on the mysteries. This practice brings consolation to Mary's Immaculate Heart and promises the grace of final perseverance.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, I desire to make reparation for offenses against you through the First Saturday devotion. Obtain for me the grace to practice it faithfully.
days.scripture: "Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother... When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, 'Woman, here is your son,' and to the disciple, 'Here is your mother.'" - John 19:25-26

days.title: Day 9: The Triumph of the Immaculate Heart
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Lady of Fatima, at Fatima you promised that 'in the end, my Immaculate Heart will triumph.' This promise gives us hope in a world often dominated by darkness, sin, and evil. Your triumph will not be a military or political victory but a triumph of grace, purity, and love over sin, hatred, and selfishness. It will be the triumph of your Son's kingdom in hearts that open themselves to His love. I long for this triumph and wish to contribute to it through my prayers, sacrifices, and daily fidelity to the message of Fatima. I commit myself to pray the rosary daily, to offer sacrifices for sinners, to practice the First Saturday devotions, and to live with devotion to your Immaculate Heart and the Sacred Heart of Jesus. O Mother, hasten the day when war will be no more, when sin will give way to grace, when hearts will be converted, and when your Son will reign in every soul. Until that day, keep me faithful to the message of Fatima and to the Gospel of your Son. May the triumph of your Immaculate Heart begin in my own heart - in my thoughts, words, and actions. May my life be a witness to the power of grace working through humble instruments. O Mother, may your triumph come soon, and may I have the joy of seeing it unfold in my lifetime. In the end, your Immaculate Heart will triumph! Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Fatima, pray for us.

Queen of the Holy Rosary, pray for us.

Immaculate Heart of Mary, be our refuge and the way that will lead us to God.
days.reflection: Mary's promise that 'in the end, my Immaculate Heart will triumph' gives hope that Christ's victory over sin and death will ultimately prevail. This triumph begins in individual hearts that open themselves to God's grace through prayer, sacrifice, and devotion.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, may your triumph come soon. Begin your triumph in my heart as I commit to living the message of Fatima through prayer, sacrifice, and daily conversion.
days.scripture: "The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you." - Romans 16:20

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to Our Lady of Fatima
notes: This novena can be prayed at any time but is especially appropriate in May (Mary's month) or in preparation for the feast of Our Lady of Fatima on May 13. The message of Fatima emphasizes daily rosary prayer, sacrifices for sinners, devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, and the Five First Saturdays devotion. Those who pray this novena are encouraged to also commit to praying the rosary daily and practicing the First Saturday devotion as Mary requested.
